method: Every non-blank value below was read from the linked official page on 2026-11-16. Blank + status "not_read_official_page" means the property publishes an official page that we have not read yet; no value is inferred and no third-party figure is used.

tax.label: Clark County combined transient lodging tax
tax.applies_to: Primary Gaming Corridor (the Strip resort corridor)
tax.excerpt: Transient Lodging Establishments located within the Primary Gaming Corridor will impose a combined transient lodging tax rate of 13.38 percent. [12.0% (current rate) + 0.5% (LVCVA expansion) + 0.88% (Stadium Construction) = 13.38%]
tax.publisher: Clark County Department of Business License (official county notice)

corroborating_official_excerpts.excerpt: Daily rates do not include the applicable Clark County Room Tax of 13.38%.
Lodging taxes apply to the basic room rate, any resort fee, additional per occupant charges, upgrades, as well as any other charges as required by applicable law.
corroborating_official_excerpts.note: This is the official confirmation that the resort fee and occupant surcharges are themselves taxed.

corroborating_official_excerpts.excerpt: Clark County licensee list shows 13.38% Transient Lodging Tax - Resort Hotel (PGC) for Bellagio, Paris Las Vegas, Park MGM, The Cosmopolitan, The LINQ, Flamingo, Harrah's, Cromwell, Sahara and Rio.
corroborating_official_excerpts.publisher: Clark County Department of Business License
corroborating_official_excerpts.note: The same county document also lists each licensee's street address.

corroborating_official_excerpts.excerpt: Live booking-engine arithmetic, captured 2026-11-17, Nov 18-22 2026 stay: room $2,827.00 + resort fee $220.00 = $3,047.00 taxable; Taxes $407.69; Total $3,454.69. And Nov 18-25 2026: room $3,594.75 + resort fee $385.00 = $3,979.75 taxable; Taxes $532.51; Total $4,512.26.

'The room tax rate for properties located INSIDE the Primary Gaming Corridor is 13.38% (see map in Appendix II). The room tax rate for properties OUTSIDE the Primary Gaming Corridor is 13.00%.' and 'Room tax should be collected from the guest and shown as a separate charge. The tax may NOT be included in the price of the room.'
corroborating_official_excerpts.publisher: City of Las Vegas, Business License Division - Transient Lodging Establishment Room Tax Instructions & Guidelines, Rev. March 2026
corroborating_official_excerpts.note: Corroborates both the rate and the method the calculator uses (tax added on top of the room rate and the resort fee, never treated as included). Jurisdiction caveat: this packet governs establishments inside City of Las Vegas limits, while the Strip properties in this dataset sit in unincorporated Clark County - which is why the Clark County guide, not this packet, is the citable source for each property's own row. Both official documents state the same 13.38% / 13.00% PGC split.

tax.cross_check: Both dated quotes imply exactly 13.3804% (407.69 / 3,047.00 and 532.51 / 3,979.75). The rate is therefore confirmed twice over: the county notice states it, and the hotel's own engine charges it. The engine also taxes the resort fee, which is the assumption behind the true-cost formula below.

formula.why: The resort fee and the additional-occupant charge are themselves taxed: Park MGM's official terms state that lodging taxes apply to "the basic room rate, any resort fee, additional per occupant charges"; the Venetian states its fee is "$55 plus applicable tax".
formula.excluded_from_nightly: Incidental deposits (authorizations, refundable), minibar, resort credit forfeitures, early-checkout fee ($100 + tax at the Venetian).
formula.parking: added as a separate line because the Venetian's own pages publish two different treatments (see flag FG-07)
